answer: The sable counter is kept in mirror and horizon shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 48 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An adversary therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 48 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Each duplicate costs another 54 dollars in locked collateral and another 7 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
